description.value: Dolpan Seoul BBQ is a Korean BBQ restaurant situated in Richmond's Sexsmith Road area, offering the communal tabletop-grill dining experience characteristic of Seoul-style BBQ. The restaurant also takes online orders for pickup and delivery directly through its own website. It would serve as a hearty refuelling stop for cyclists exploring the Richmond area.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 51m; rack at 74m; rack at 82m; rack at 95m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at dolpanbbq.com confirms the business is open, provides an address (1123-3779 Sexsmith Rd, Richmond) and phone ((604) 273-9220) not present in OSM tags, and explicitly advertises online ordering for pickup and delivery. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags. A notable discrepancy: the website's HTML title reads 'Authentic Korean Restaurant in Burnaby' but the listed address is in Richmond, consistent with the OSM community field — likely a copy error on the website.
concerns: Website page title reads 'Authentic Korean Restaurant in Burnaby' but the address listed on the same page and the OSM community both indicate Richmond — likely a website copy/paste error.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible Korean restaurant in Richmond with confirmed address and hours — a valid food stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Address and phone were sourced from the website; OSM record contained neither.

wow_evidence: Korean BBQ restaurant situated in Richmond's Sexsmith Road area
